Files already mined+fixed by recent PRs (#2993 callback i18n, #2984 listings error state, #2968 feedcard mutation) were deliberately excluded from this pass.
landability_note: reality-web is a Next.js frontend app; findings here ARE landable in the cloud runner (unlike backend api-server, blocked by utoipa-swagger-ui build-script egress-403 #2966, and mobile-native KMP, AGP egress-gated). All three findings are frontend-only edits verifiable via `pnpm --filter @ppt/reality-web typecheck` + Vitest/RTL.
note: Static analysis only (read + grep, no build/test) per skill contract. reality-web is a mature, well-hardened segment: SSR data-fetch helpers (lib/layout.ts, lib/tenant-config.ts, lib/page-metadata.ts) all handle non-ok responses and never throw out of the SSR layer; the flagship listings/[slug]/page.tsx validates the response body before render and emits a real 404. Net-new findings this pass center on i18n/a11y completeness and dead-code drift, not correctness crashes. Cap of 3 respected; highest-severity kept.

evidence: Accessibility labels across LIVE, mounted components bypass the next-intl i18n layer and are hardcoded in a single language on a 4-locale portal (sk/cs/de/en). Screen-reader users on any non-matching locale hear the wrong-language announcement for core controls.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/ui/Header.tsx:183 — `aria-label="Toggle menu"` hardcoded English, even though the same component already uses `const t = useTranslations(...)` for every visible nav string (t('nav.sell'), t('common.login'), etc). Header is rendered on essentially every page (imported per-page: price-map, journal, profile, report, loading, ...), so this is reachable site-wide.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/ui/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:157 — `aria-label="Select language"` hardcoded English on the listbox; LanguageSwitcher is mounted inside Header (Header.tsx:105) => present on every page.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/listings/SearchBar.tsx:162 `aria-label="Clear search"` and frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/listings/ListingFilters.tsx:128 `aria-label="Close filters"` — hardcoded English on the core public listings search/filter UX; frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/listings/ListingDetailContent.tsx:144 `aria-label="Breadcrumb"`; frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/loading.tsx:11 `aria-label="Loading page"`; frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/forbidden/page.tsx:29 `title="Access denied"` on the 403 page.

Wrong-language (not merely untranslated) labels: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/terms/page.tsx:56 and privacy/page.tsx:42 use `aria-label="Obsah"` (Slovak), cookies/page.tsx:234 uses `aria-label="Nastavenia cookies"` (Slovak), and account/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx:531 uses `alt="Foto"` (Slovak) — so EN/DE/CS visitors get Slovak screen-reader/alt text. This is an a11y correctness defect, not just a missing key.

Landable frontend-only remedy: route each of these through the existing t() / getTranslations namespaces and add the keys to messages/{en,sk,cs,de}.json, matching how the surrounding visible text in the same files is already localized. Verifiable via `pnpm --filter @ppt/reality-web typecheck` + an RTL test asserting the localized aria-label under a non-en locale. Confidence high: Header + LanguageSwitcher are provably mounted on every page and the attributes render unconditionally.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/comparison/CompareButton.tsx is exported from the feature barrel (components/comparison/index.ts:7, Epic 51 Property Comparison) but is consumed NOWHERE in the app: grep for `CompareButton` across src/**/*.{ts,tsx} returns only its own definition and the barrel re-export. Its sibling ComparisonTray IS wired into app/[locale]/layout.tsx:261, so the tray (view/remove) is live but the per-listing add/remove entry point is not — the comparison feature has no in-card affordance to ADD a listing.

CompareButton.tsx:47 — `title={inComparison ? 'Remove from comparison' : 'Add to comparison'}` is hardcoded English with no useTranslations import (grep count 0), so even once wired it would leak English tooltips on the 4-locale portal.

ListingCard.tsx (the component actually rendered per card in ListingGrid) correctly uses `useTranslations('listing')` and contains no compare control — confirming the button was built but never mounted.

Remedy: either wire CompareButton into ListingCard (and localize its title via t()), or, if the in-card compare entry point was intentionally dropped, remove CompareButton + its barrel export to stop it drifting. Low severity: no live user impact today (dead export), but it is a completeness gap in the shipped comparison feature.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/auth-button.tsx exports `AuthButton()` but it is imported nowhere (grep for `AuthButton`/`auth-button` across src returns only the definition). The LIVE auth control is the inline auth-slot inside components/ui/Header.tsx:115-176. AuthButton is an orphaned duplicate.

The orphan has DRIFTED from the live Header slot: auth-button.tsx:161 links to `/profile` whereas Header.tsx:158 links to `/account/profile`; the orphan is missing the Header's `/saved-searches` (Header.tsx:143) and `/inquiries` (Header.tsx:150) menu entries. A future edit that revives this component would ship stale navigation.

It also violates two repo-wide reality-web conventions: (1) uses raw `<a href="/favorites">` (L158) and `<a href="/profile">` (L161) instead of the locale-aware `Link` from `@/i18n/routing` used everywhere else (Header.tsx, Footer.tsx, CookieConsentBanner.tsx, home/*), so its links would drop the `[locale]` prefix; (2) hardcodes English 'Sign In' (L127), 'My Favorites' (L159), 'Profile' (L162), 'Sign Out' (L165) with no useTranslations.

Remedy: delete components/auth-button.tsx (dead code). Low severity — not mounted, so no live impact — but removing it prevents accidental revival of drifted, non-localized, non-locale-prefixed nav. Verifiable via `pnpm --filter @ppt/reality-web typecheck` (no importers to break).
